subject.title: fix: CLI auth status/probe path regression

question: Does current main still need this exact CLI status/probe external-credential discovery scope after the later auth and CLI-helper refactors?
rationale: The branch predates current main by months and is conflicted, while the supplied related work shows both a merged auth-overlay foundation and an open broader probe-path issue; source-level current-main comparison is required to choose rebase, supersession, or closure.

options.title: Refresh and retain the fix
options.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve only the still-missing scoped-discovery behavior, and rerun focused status/probe coverage.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this branch if current main or a canonical follow-up already gives status and probe callers the same configured external-CLI credential visibility.

options.title: Adopt through the broader helper-path work
options.body: Fold any remaining discovery-scope gap into the canonical CLI-helper repair so probe dispatch and target construction are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Refresh and retain the fix
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve only the still-missing scoped-discovery behavior, and rerun focused status/probe coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged auth-overlay scoping work is the clearest available ownership signal for this contract.
